parts.detail: needs live multi-node serving. WARNING: the PR's own offline proxy for it, the 64K-100K multi-turn stress probe, is BELOW 1107 on the candidate image: 99.38% vs 99.68% (tp3) and 98.97% vs 99.54% (tp4), driven by turns after eviction (evicted-turn mean 97.75% vs 99.79% tp3, 95.94% vs 99.58% tp4)

verdict_scope: sp8-evaluable part only (the probe's unit-level checks); the live hit-share part is cannot-evaluate-on-sp8, and its offline proxy points the wrong way
reason: The probe's boundary, spec-decode, LRU-order and long-decode checks pass on both candidate-48 boots and fail on 1107, so the fixes are present and effective in the integrated image. But the README's headline claim (1107 at 57% overall hit rate under the stress workload) is not reproduced: 1107 measures 99.68% / 99.54% on the same probe, above the candidate's 99.38% / 98.97%. The candidate is better on every non-evicted turn (+256 tokens) and worse on the turns after eviction (up to -4,864 tokens per turn on tp4), so the tail-to-root eviction order costs more than the decode-frontier retention gains on this workload. The live hit-share comparison should be watched closely; the offline proxy predicts it will be below 1107.
